parttime.description:
PartTime is a modern POS, daily sales tracker, and team management app designed for small businesses, cafes, stores, and part-time staff. 

Key Features:
- Fast POS & Sales Logging: Track daily cash, card, and tip sales effortlessly.
- Decentralized Workspace Setup: Create a new Parttime workspace instantly as an Admin or join an existing store as an Employee.
- Intelligent Join Code Generator: Real-time, smart code suggestions for team access.
- Role-Based Access Control: Secure separate views for Managers and Staff.
- Real-Time Analytics & Reports: Visualize daily, monthly, and annual sales trends.
- Employee Scheduling & Announcements: Manage work shifts and team updates in one place.
